en.headline: Sun says government will help firms run childcare in Northern Metropolis
en.dek: Labour chief Chris Sun told RTHK workplace centres there could follow the airport preschool model, as the city looks for more places for children under two.
body: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said the government will support companies that want to set up childcare centres in the Northern Metropolis, speaking in an interview with RTHK’s Vision 15 programme.

Sun said centres there could follow the Airport Preschool model used for airport staff. He acknowledged that centres must meet legal standards, but said officials are ready to assist firms that want to run one for employees. He said the new district is industry-driven and will also have a university town, so workers’ childcare needs may differ from other areas.

Citywide, he said the focus remains on more diverse options especially for infants under two, including centres closer to workplaces so parents can drop off and collect children more easily. The comments follow earlier remarks that extra subsidised standalone child care places through 2029 would be aimed at the same age group.

zh.headline: 孫玉菡：政府支援企業在北部都會區開設託兒
zh.dek: 勞福局長接受港台訪問時表示，北部都會區託兒可參考機場員工幼兒中心模式，並重申會增加兩歲以下名額。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡接受港台《港好十五五》訪問時表示，政府會支援有意在北部都會區開設幼兒中心的企業。
他指該區中心可參考機場員工幼兒中心模式。他承認中心須符合法定標準，但若企業有意為員工營辦，政府會全力協助。他說北部都會區以產業帶動，亦有大學城，在職人士的託兒需求或與其他地區不同。
全港層面，他指重點仍是提供更多元選擇，尤其是兩歲以下嬰幼兒，包括靠近工作地點的中心，方便家長接送。有關說法與早前指2029年前新增資助獨立幼兒中心名額會集中0至2歲的方向一致。
